rule: margin before the play above 38 points in the 2nd quarter, 28 in the 3rd, 22 in the 4th (CFBD's documented rule)
why: Measured on 2014-2025 team stats (garbage_time_test.csv): CFBD's rule predicts later-game margin slightly better than no filter (mean |r| 0.426 vs 0.422) and keeps the same full-season reliability (0.700 vs 0.703). The win-probability filter (naive WP under 2% or over 98%) throws out 2.5x as many plays (about 19% vs 8%, nearly half of all fourth-quarter plays), which costs reliability (0.684) for no extra predictive value (0.423). The CFBD rule also needs no model, so anyone can check it against a scoreboard.
